title: Japan PM Takaichi arrives for 49th ASEAN Summit
summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi arrived in the Philippines on Monday afternoon, November 16, 2026, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

blocks.text: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi arrived in the Philippines on Monday afternoon, November 16, 2026, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
Upon her arrival at the airport, Takaichi was welcomed by Pasay City Mayor Imelda Calixto-Rubiano and Public Works Secretary Giovanni Lopez.
Takaichi is Japan's first female prime minister.
Earlier on Monday, leaders from South Korea and New Zealand have likewise arrived in the country to attend the Summit.
The 49th ASEAN Summit is scheduled from November 16 to 18, following its opening ceremony held on Sunday, November 15.
The Philippines is hosting this year's ASEAN Summit and is set to turn over the chairmanship to Singapore. —Lyjah Tiffany Bonzo/RF, GMA News
